newsitem.title: UK: Nightfreight sees IT spending, shares fall.
newsitem.headline: Nightfreight sees IT spending, shares fall.

text.p: Nightfreight Plc said on Wednesday that heavy investment in information technology and various quality initiatives to enhance service levels will have a cost impact in the first six months.
Shares in the company were down 14-1/2p at 59p by 0841 GMT despite news that Nightfreight's pretax profits for the year to November 30, 1996 rose 8.5 percent to 5.01 million stg.

The parcels delivery, contract distribution and freight forwarding group said in a statement accompanying annual results that the benefits of these measures will "be felt increasingly over the medium term."
